summary: In a starving future, NARRATOR (Thomas) warns the viewer about Moral Dilemma, where contestants sell loved ones' lives for AI-set prices. Host ARCHIBALD wants a spectacle from SUZIE, who collects friends to cash in and has already sold Phillis. She drew boyfriend DURAND, refused 45,000 and gambled on a hacked video, sure his ring made him valuable. The video showed roommate BARRY (PCB officer) telling Durand he will be a contestant and persuading him to stage an engagement and sell the fiancée; Durand, moved by Suzie's kindness when his mother died, still chose her to die. Suzie saw it all and is crushed; Durand's price fell to 7,224. Durand does not know Suzie is selling him. Archibald promises her one more opportunity, then cuts to an ad selling the home app, in which children start fighting. Archibald holds the power.
